## Why this name

- Exact inverse of BtlObjPoolAlloc: unlinks from the active list at 0x030040A4, pushes onto the free list at 0x030040AC, and increments the live count at 0x030040B4
- Releases the node's status/bit through sub_0806FBF8 first, but only when status >= 0 and (node->unk20 & 1) == 0, then sets node->unk24 = -1
- Also moves the node's BtlObj to the head of the display list and clears node->unk30, then re-bases sub_0806F8C4 on the active list head
